faq.q: How does the Quran habit tracker work?
faq.a: Set a daily verse goal, read verse by verse with the timer, and tap I'm Done — your verses, time, hasanat and streak save to your free account automatically.

faq.q: Do I need an account to track my reading?
faq.a: Yes — a free login with Google or email saves your goal, streak, Juz progress and bookmarks so you can continue where you left off on any device. Everything is free forever.

faq.q: How can I read the Quran with translation?
faq.a: Open any of the 114 surahs or 30 paras — every verse shows Arabic text with Urdu, English and Hindi meaning, transliteration and audio.
